---
title: "Logo path that is not a valid Windows filename"
format: revealjs
logo: img/top*.png
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      noErrors: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<img src="img/top\*\.png" class="slide-logo"'
        - []
---

Checking whether `img/top*.png` exists only relative to the project must not fail the render where `*` is invalid in a filename (Windows). The path is left as written.
